lines.text: A sinful woman brought an alabaster jar of perfume to a Pharisee's house and anointed Jesus' feet.
The Pharisee thought Jesus was no prophet, but Jesus answered him, "Simon, I have something to tell you."
Jesus told of two debtors, one owing five hundred denarii and the other ten, and the moneylender forgave both.
Jesus told Simon he gave Him no water for His feet, no kiss, and no oil for His hands.
The Twelve traveled with Jesus, along with Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Susanna, and many women who provided from their own means.
